findings.summary: ball/cage: synthetic-only, uncalibrated amplitude. The ball and cage classes were trained on simulated faults whose mechanical amplitude (CALIBRATED_MECHANICAL_SEVERITY in datagen/scenario.py) is a placeholder: KAt has no clean single-defect code for these faults, so it cannot be calibrated without real data.
2048-sample (205 ms) windows: start-up transient accuracy 0.50; steady state 1.00 at 150 rad/s, 1.00 at 100 rad/s (cage recall 1.00).
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only. Recorded test accuracy 0.902; no real-machine validation exists.
